label: startExport ignores exportProblem
find: guard exportProblem == nil else { return false }

label: a CancellationError ends the run failed, not idle
exportProgressed maps the fraction with ceil
retryExport from finished reopens the sheet
find: guard case .failed(let o, _) = exportState else { return }
replace: guard let o = exportingOptions else { return }

label: exportingOptions reads nil while running
find:
case .idle: nil
        case .editing(let o), .running(let o, _, _), .finished(let o, _), .failed(let o, _): o
replace:
case .idle, .running: nil
        case .editing(let o), .finished(let o, _), .failed(let o, _): o
